title: Midday exec docket
content:
WED 2026-03-13 — midday capture / working list

Top-level intent for today:
- Keep platform rollout on track for Friday demo; remove blockers, not re-architect.
- Shortlist two fallback routing policies to present at 3pm leadership sync.
- Clean up outstanding customer asks (SLA language) and hand off to Legal by EOD.

Immediate windows (timeboxed)
- 12:30–12:50: buffer for urgent escalation (blocked by infra alert)
- 13:00–13:20: 1:1 w/ Clara (handoff: Dedicated capacity docs, set owner)
  prep: clarify which parts of capacity plan Clara owns (autoscale, burst policy)
  ask: confirm gaps in telemetry for burst events (metric names to add to dashboard)
- 14:00–14:30: Deep work — draft SLO update email for key customers (short, 3 bullets)
- 15:00–15:30: Leadership sync — present routing fallback options + cost delta
  slide note: two options (regional fallback, model-variant fallback), expected p95 latency impact, cost delta per 1M requests
- 16:00–16:20: Quick sync w/ Ben (GTM readiness for Dedicated launch)

Agenda notes & prep items
- Leadership sync (15:00)
  - One-slide summary for each option: operational complexity, rollback story, customer-visible impact.
  - Bring the empiric numbers from the perf run on 2026-03-11 (see linked PR)
  - Decision goal: pick primary + secondary fallback by Friday end-of-day.

- 1:1 w/ Clara
  - Deliverable: updated capacity plan draft (v2) with owner names inline.
  - Action: Clara to open a PR against docs repo and tag me + SRE. Deadline: Thu 03-14 COB.

Action items (capture + owners)
- A1: Draft 3-bullet SLO update email -> Jordan (today EOD) -> send to legal for language check (Ben)
- A2: Add two burst telemetry metrics to dashboard -> Clara (Thu 03-14) -> link telemetry ticket in convo
- A3: Prepare cost delta calc for fallback options -> ML infra (Ben) + Jordan review (tomorrow)
- A4: Code-level rollback checklist for model-variant fallback -> Eng-Serving-Runtime (owner: Priya) -> target Thu morning
- A5: Follow-up with ACME integration team about data retention ask -> Jordan -> ask for sample retention policy by Fri

Quick triage / inbox bullets
- Customer: ACME — urgent: encryption at rest Q. Reply template ready, need to add KMS integration timeline.
- Legal: review SLA clause draft (see CONFLUENCE-8342). Pinged Raj (in Legal) at 09:12 — awaiting reply.
- Infra alert from earlier: temporary spike due to Canary traffic misrouted. Root cause: mis-labeled route in routing table (fixed). Postmortem stub created (JIRA-1197).

Unresolved questions / flags
- Q1: If we choose model-variant fallback, what's the expected quality delta for top-5 prompts? Need eval sets. -> assigned to Applied ML to run quick eval (Ben to coordinate).
- Q2: Can Dedicated customers opt into regional-only fallback? Need product decision.

Notes to self (short-form)
- Keep slides tight (no more than 4 bullets per slide)
- Ask Clara for one sample dashboard screenshot to include in slides
- Re-evaluate cost assumptions after Ben's calc
- If Legal doesn't turn SLA draft around by Thu, escalate to Sarah

Meeting follow-ups to schedule
- Post-leadership: 30m technical debrief with Priya + SRE to convert decision to runbook (same day preferred)
- Friday: dry run of demo (30m) — invite Ben, Clara, Priya

End-of-day capture (template)
- Wins: (fill)
- Blockers: (fill)
- Follow-ups for tomorrow: (fill)

Random scratch lines (notes-to-self fragments)
- PR#4321 perf numbers look cleaner than expected — re-run with longer context length?
- Slack thread: #platform-ops -> pin decision summary after leadership sync
- Consider quick note to customers about fallback approach, but only after leadership decision

---
Last edits: quick rewrite of SLO bullets, trimmed.
